Package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.usb

package io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.usb
USB serial output: Serial and its BaudRate constants.

Serial is the primary way a running Juno program is observable at all, since the board has no attached debugger or console (see docs/SERIAL.md in the project documentation). print/println accept an int or a compile-time string literal only — Juno has no heap for a runtime-built String — so computed values are printed as separate literal/int calls rather than one formatted string.
